senses.gloss: to assume shape, form a texture; (of trees) to show a distinct shape of fruits, to form fruits; (of fruits and leaves) to assume a distinct shape (v. חֲנָטָה).
units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 14b:8">R. Hash. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>אתרוג שחָנְטוּ פירותיו</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>פירותיה</he>) an Ethrog-tree whose fruits were formed before the fifteenth of Shebat.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 14b">Ib.</cite> <he>אילן שחנטו וכ׳</he> a tree whose fruits &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 5:1:3">Y. Shebi. V, beg. 35ᵈ</cite> <he>אילן שח׳</he> a tree which formed fruits.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 4:20">Tosef. Shebi. IV, 20</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: [to be handsome; (Arab.) to be red,] to make handsome, or flagrant, esp. toembalm.
